title: Particles, Fields and The Future of Physics - A Lecture by Sean Carroll
summary: Sean Carroll's 2013 Fermilab Users Meeting lecture on particles, fields and the future of particle physics. He explains that particles are vibrations in underlying quantum fields and touches on the Higgs, neutrinos and dark matter.
why: HN recommends it as the clearest long-form explanation of the everything-is-fields view for non-physicists.

quote.text: Sean Carroll is a master of making quantum mechanics approachable to non-physicists.
